confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Krakow price levels, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.9x beer, wine glass about 1.15x beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. USD values assume roughly 3.7 PLN per USD from general knowledge, not a live rate. The FX value was read from search results for the RBA overview page; the page itself was not opened, and no 14 October figure was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Central European tourist cities such as Wroclaw, Gdansk and Budapest for everyday prices, set below Prague for restaurants and bars. Old Town and Kazimierz tourist premiums and July peak-season demand applied to accommodation.
